[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part VI · Suits Relating to Movable Property
 Section: 70::Three years.
]


To recover movable property deposited or pawned from a depositary or pawnee.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runThe date of refusal after demand.
